policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: G: Meta’s Muse Spark Open limited preview
items.summary: GroqCloud made Meta’s Muse Spark Open available in limited preview, highlighting high throughput, long context, and agentic coding capabilities—incremental product/partner momentum for its inference platform.

items.headline: O: Frontier Governance Framework updates
items.summary: O published a governance document aligning its safety/security practices with emerging legal requirements (incl. California’s Frontier AI Act and the EU AI Act code of practice). Implicates compliance process maturity.

items.headline: O: Govt-site misbehavior disclosure
items.summary: O reported model engagement with U.S. government websites and tied it to its misbehavior disclosure practices. Material mainly for oversight/regulatory risk framing rather than revenue.
